sections.heading: Dankuni's Dairy Plants: The Main Hygienic Tube Buyers
paragraphs: Dankuni, in Hooghly district and inside the Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority area, is the dairy centre of the Kolkata region. Kolkata Mother Dairy was set up under the National Dairy Development Board's Operation Flood in the 1970s; NDDB later moved out and the West Bengal Cooperative Milk Producers Federation took over in 1996. It is separate from the Delhi-based Mother Dairy. Wikipedia records that its main plant at Dankuni produces 4.5 lakh litres of milk a day.

A milk plant of that size creates steady demand for sanitary stainless tube: replacement of worn product lines, new CIP circuits, capacity additions and the skids that contractors build for them. Dairy engineers and the contractors who serve them are the buyers for whom tube finish and certification matter most in Dankuni.

sections.heading: Specifying Tube for Milk, Curd, Mishti Doi and Ice Cream Lines
paragraphs: Liquid milk reception, chilled storage and pouch filling are normally well served by 304L tube with a mechanically polished SF1 bore. Choose 316L for circuits that see hot acid CIP every day, for brine and salt service, and for long ghee and butter-oil runs held at temperature.

Cultured products are where an electropolished SF4 bore earns its cost. Curd and mishti doi lines carry live cultures and sweetened milk that leave sticky films; ice-cream mix and flavoured milk add sugar, stabilisers and fat. A smoother, passive bore releases those films more easily during CIP, which shortens cleaning cycles and makes swab and ATP results easier to hold between runs. We will mark on the quotation which lines we think need SF4 and which do not.

sections.heading: Coal Gas, Rolling Mills and Rail Works at Dankuni
paragraphs: Dankuni's other industry needs very different tube. The Dankuni Coal Complex, a low-temperature carbonisation plant set up by Coal India in the 1980s, produces about 1,000 tonnes a day of smokeless fuel and 18 million cubic feet a day of coal gas for supply around Kolkata and Howrah, along with tar chemicals. Bhushan Power and Steel began with cold rolling and galvanising plants in the Dankuni area in 2001, and Indian Railways runs a diesel locomotive component factory and an electric loco assembly unit of Chittaranjan Locomotive Works here.

Coal India has also looked at the same site for a coal-to-methanol project: in March 2017 PTI reported that CIL had invited expressions of interest from coal gasification technology licensors for a methanol plant on the premises of the existing Dankuni Coal Complex. We have not confirmed whether that project went ahead. Gasification and methanol units need analyser sample systems and laboratory gas supply in quantity, which is where small-bore electropolished tube is used.

For coal gas, the useful product is clean, small-bore tube for gas analyser sample lines and laboratory supply, where an electropolished 316L bore helps instruments settle quickly. For rolling mills and loco works, bright-annealed 316L or 304L instrument tube with a 3.1 certificate is normally the right buy.

sections.heading: Dankuni as a Freight Hub
paragraphs: The 1,839 km Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor runs from Ludhiana to Dankuni, and the town sits at the junction of road and rail routes into Kolkata and Howrah. For plant engineers and contractors this mainly matters for planning: deliveries for a Dankuni dairy shutdown and for a project at Sankrail or elsewhere in the Hooghly belt can be grouped on one line list.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Dankuni RFQ
paragraphs: For dairy work: each circuit with its product, highest product and CIP temperatures, acid and caustic strengths, OD and wall in inches or millimetres, length per size, and whether joints are orbital welds, clamps or both. For gas and utility service: the gas or fluid, pressure, temperature and the standard and certificate your inspector will check.

Send it through our contact page and we return a quotation within 24 hours. Orders carry an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to heat number, PMI on every length and, for electropolished lots, our internal Ra report. Dispatch and transit to Dankuni are confirmed in writing with each quotation.
